# Xhavic

> Xhavic is an Ethereum Layer 2 execution network. It delivers 2,000+ TPS with ~$0.04 average fees and sub-200ms finality. All state settles on Ethereum. Fully EVM-compatible.

## Key Features

- **Dual Wallet System**: Instant Wallet (irreversible, sub-200ms finality for DeFi) and Secure Wallet (reversible transactions with 24-hour escrow window for institutional operations).
- **Native Oracle Layer**: Price feeds and data services as EVM precompiles. No external oracle dependencies.
- **AI Agent Execution**: Deterministic ordering, floating-point precompiles, and predictable gas costs for autonomous on-chain agents.
- **Real World Assets**: 24-hour escrow enables tokenized real estate, commodities, and digital securities with institutional-grade compliance.

## Network

- Mainnet Chain ID: 7849
- Testnet Chain ID: 7850
- Mainnet RPC: https://rpc.xhavic.io
- Testnet RPC: https://testnet-rpc.xhavic.io
- Block time: 2 seconds
